description: Enables holiday mode until the given timestamp (`holiday_until` in ISO 8601) or disables it if `holiday_until` is omitted. While active, personal notifications are suppressed; monitors keep running and incidents are still recorded.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

holiday_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (must be in the future) at which holiday mode ends. Omit to disable holiday mode.

name: holiday_mode_set
title: Enable or disable holiday mode
